title: Strange Statues Cave
description:
**Puzzle:** Every statue holds up a different number of fingers. Press the buttons on the statues showing 2, 3, 5 and 7 fingers (the prime numbers). 

One statue has lost an arm, and the arm lies in a pile of rocks in the corner of the cave. That statue stands for 7. If you press a button on a wrong statue by mistake, you can pop it back out with a button on the statue's back. The order of pressing makes no difference. This button is hard to spot, so use Eagle Eye and first person view.

**Reward:** Gold Bar x3 (worth $1500 total!)

title: Strange Statues - Painting
description:
A large rock formation with a hole through its middle stands in this area.  Go into the round opening in the rock to examine a painting.

Whether before or after finding this painting, you can go to the [Strange Statues Cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=153) and solve its puzzle to get three gold bars (which sell for $500 each.)

title: Native Burial Site
description:

Lighting a fire in the center of the stone circle makes it rain.

title: Face in Cliff
description:
A Mount Rushmore-esque face cut into the mountain. Come from the north to reach the top. 

The sculptor took his own life and left a note, which you can take from his body - "Note from the Sculptor"

title: Barrel Rider
description: A thrill seeker rode a barrel over Donner Falls. It ended just as you'd expect.

title: Crashed Airship
description:
The remains of a flying machine with a corpse inside.

This might be an Easter Egg nodding to the Kinnear family from Red Dead Redemption 1. Charles Kinnear builds an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission, and you can find another of his machines in this game while exploring [New Austin](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=894).  

The wreck here _could_ be the work of Charles' brother Percival, since the corpse wears glasses strikingly like Charles's.

title: Manmade Mutant
description:
A gruesome frankenstein experiment, assembled from assorted animal parts.


Get into the building by climbing through the window on the second floor, over the southwest porch.

title: Oil Derrick
description:
A letter from the vice president of Cornwall Kerosene & Tar is on the body by the Derrick, while [Dinosaur Bone #3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=53) is inside it.

Ginseng Elixir is in the abandoned camp.

title: Abandoned Trading Post
description: Raise one of the floor planks to uncover a hidden stash.

title: Circus Wagons
description: A fortune telling machine sits inside the blue wagon.

title: Bolger Glade
description: Go up to the cannons in the middle of the battlefield to add this POI to your journal.

title: Donkey Lady
description:
Examine the corpse of a woman with a donkey skull tied to the wheel.

This references a glitch in the first Red Dead Redemption, in which the game spawned an NPC with a donkey's behaviour and face. 

The glitch gained popularity after the YouTube channel WhereDaBootz posted [a video](https://youtu.be/7q7v4F8r9Og?si=Sxr_CjGACSl5iZ1L) showing it off.

title: Flying Machine
description:
The remains of a flying machine, with "Charles Kinnear" written on the back.

This references a character of the same name from the first Red Dead Redemption, who builds an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission. The wreck here is probably the work of a younger Charles, who evidently didn't get any better at his craft as he aged.

A stone obelisk with 3 sides, set on a square stone. A plaque on the west side carries the date 1771 and the latin phrase, "Hora fugit, ne tardes" meaning "The hour flees, don't be late", a common motto on sun dials.

Pry off the plaque to find a gold earring and another treasure map.

description: **Location:** On the left side of the blue building, on a wooden pole in the water

title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #6
description: **Location:** On the roof.

title: Painting in Cabin
description:
The finished painting is visible only in the epilogue. 

Note: People used to think 100% completion was needed to examine this location, but that is not so.

title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #4
description: **Location:** In the alley behind the general store - on the wall

title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #2
description: **Location:** On the roof of the mortuary

title: Coal Mine Writing
description:
At the bottom of the Annesburg coal mine, in the tunnel farthest to the northwest, carved into the wooden wall. It goes into the player's journal without comment, and acts as the unofficial beginning of the [Reed Cottage Treasure](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=665).


**North Bennet Flew**

**North Bennett Flue**

**Red Roof, Green Door**

**Brothers I’ll be poor no more.**



This clue is meant to send the player to [Reed Cottage](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30359), north of Annesburg, where the chimney should be checked to find the [Sketched Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30359).

title: Homestead Stash - Chez Porter
description:
**Requirements**: Chapter 2

Climb a ladder in the barn to the floor above, where the stash box sits next to some hay stacks. The treasure box holds 2 x $50 and a jewelry bag. Make sure to loot everything else in the houses as well.

title: Homestead Stash - Aberdeen Pig Farm
description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards

On arriving at the farm, a man sitting on the porch greets you. Greet him back, talk to him and follow him into his house. Then rob the place. Also make sure to go back outside and use the door on the southern side of the house. It leads to the room with the stash. This door stays closed until you have followed the man into his house. It's a little lockbox with 2 x $20 inside, so loot that along with everything else in the house.

title: Homestead Stash - Lonnie's Shack
description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 2

There are 4 men inside Lonnie's Shack. Kill 3 of them and leave 1 alive. Point your gun at the last survivor and threaten him. He then tells you where the stash is. It differs depending on which man is left alive.

**Important**: Save manually first.  Without interrogating the last man, you can't get the stash.

title: Homestead Stash - Van Horn Mansion
description: Come here early in the game to find two residents inside. Go in at night and you'll find two people asleep on the lower floor. Take the money from their table and loot everything else in the house.

title: Homestead Stash - Catfish Jacksons
description: A father and son live at this homestead, though sometimes only the son is inside. Spot the shotgun in the living room, and threaten the son to find out where the [stash](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=810) is.

title: Homestead Stash - Watson's Cabin
description:
An old lady lives in Watson's Cabin. Go into her house and take the ladder at the back down to the cellar. Take her [Semi-Automatic Shotgun](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=439453) and leave. 

Come back to the cabin the following day and you'll meet the lady's four sons. Kill them all, and a lockbox, which wasn't there before, appears on the kitchen table. The lockbox is the secret stash and holds 1 x $73.

**Bonus:** Look in the nightstand drawer for a Gold Earring.

title: Homestead Stash - Willard's Rest
description:
**Requirements:** Available after finishing the first story mission in Chapter 6

Speak with the resident here and teach her to hunt. Come back 2 days later. On your return, hold a shooting contest with her, and then you can loot her lockbox. Make sure to loot everything else too.

title: Shop Robbery: Rhodes Gunsmith
description:
Speak to the trapped man through the Gunsmith's basement window. After he tells you his story, you can hold up the store's owner and force him to take you down to the basement.  

There you can loot the room, free the man, and get a **Lancaster Repeater**.

title: Shop Robbery: Strawberry General Store
description:
Look through the basement window before going into the store. Then go inside and hold up the owner to make him open the trapdoor to the basement. Threaten him some more and he'll point out a loose brick in the wall.  

Examine the brick and loot the basement to finish the robbery.

title: Robbery: Saint Denis Gunsmith
description:
Inside the gunsmith is a security door, and you should knock on it before holding up the owner. When he opens the door for you, kill the guard on the other side and head to the top floor of the building. There you'll find an illegal poker room to loot, and a secret safe that the players reveal if you threaten them.  

You earn bonus points for finishing the robbery without firing a single shot!

title: Robbery: Valentine Doctor
description: Before holding up the doctor and forcing him to open the back room, knock on the door at the rear of the building or inside the doctor's surgery. Get away fast to avoid a large bounty, but remember to take the money and the **Schofield Revolver**.

title: Coach Robbery: Hector (I, II & III)
description:
**Requirements:** Complete *Friends in Very Low Places* (Chapter 3)  

Hector is a clerk in Strawberry post office who gives you 3 coach robbery missions in all. Buy the information from him and read the notes in your satchel for the mission details and coach locations.  

You can deliver stolen coaches to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.

title: Coach Robbery: Alden (I, II & III)
description:
**Requirements:** Complete *Friends in Very Low Places* (Chapter 3)  

Alden is a clerk in Rhodes post office who gives you 3 coach robbery missions in all. Buy the information from him and read the notes in your satchel for the mission details and coach locations.  

You can deliver stolen coaches to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.

title: Rock Carving #2
description: This carving faces the river.

title: Rock Carving #1
description: This carving sits where the road ends on Mount Hagen.

title: Rock Carving #4
description:
Walk to the mountain's edge and follow the narrow pass down to reach this carving.
Alternatively, jump down from the mountaintop shown in the screenshot.

title: Rock Carving #3
description: Approach the mountains from the river's southern side. After climbing to the top, you'll spot a passage running down between the trees. The carving is close to the top, facing the river.

title: Rock Carving #8
description: A rock on the plateau just south of Moonstone Pond has a pyramid carved into it.

title: Rock Carving #9
description: This carving faces the road.

title: Rock Carving #10
description: This carving is by the road, east of the Elysian Pool.

title: Rock Carving #7
description: This carving is close to the very top of a cliff.

title: Rock Carving #6
description: Walk to the mountain's edge and follow a path down to a giant skeleton. Go around the corner and the carving is there, facing the valley below the mountain.

title: Rock Carving #5
description: This carving is visible from the western shore of Owanjila Lake.

title: Old Harry Fen Shack
description:
This shack stands in the woods south of Braithwaite Manor. Inside are a picture of a slave's family and a newspaper clipping that offers a reward for catching a runaway slave.

Once you've finished Chapter 3 and captured [Mark Johnson](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=304), finding this newspaper unlocks a new bounty target - [Robbie Laidlaw](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=554).

title: Lenora View
description: This blue shack stands beside the road on the eastern slopes of Mount Shann. Next to the front door are a bouquet of flowers and a letter from a man heading off to [pick up his new wife](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785).

title: Clawson's Rest
description: This shack stands just beyond the Dakota River and the railroad. Inside, a pulp novel lies on a small bedside table, and [a letter](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892190) is in the drawer.

title: Dodd's Bluff
description: This cabin sits in a valley just south of Window Rock. Inside is a murder scene with a gold nugget.

title: Fairvale Shanty
description: _Note: There is usually a grizzly bear or a small pack of wolves in the area._

title: Ridge View Cabin
description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

title: Vetter's Echo Cabin
description: ||Opening the front door will trigger a bear attack. You can ambush the bear yourself by entering through the cabin's broken back door.||

title: Shepherd's Rise Cabin
description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

title: Argil Rise Cabin
description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

title: Taxidermist House
description: Home of the taxidermist. You're invited to this cabin once all five hunting requests are done.

title: Adler Ranch
description: **Requirements:** Chapter 2

title: Firwood Rise
description:
Home of Deborah MacGuinness.
She can be heard inside the shed.

title: Stilt Shack
description: Salted meat, moonshine, and predator bait are inside.

title: The Old Bacchus Place
description: Full of perfect-quality rats. A [Fertility Statue](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=963) is hidden in the chimney.

title: Watson's Cabin
description:
Inside Watson's Cabin lives an old lady. Go into her house and take the ladder at the back down to the cellar. Steal her [Semi-Automatic Shotgun](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=439453) and leave.

Come back to the cabin the following day and you'll meet the lady's four sons. Kill them all, and a lockbox will appear on the kitchen table where there was none before. It's the secret stash and holds 1 x $73.

Visit again a day later and you'll find a tombstone for the old lady and a newspaper clipping inside the cabin

**Bonus:** Check the nightstand drawer for a Gold Earring.

title: Witches Cauldron
description: Drink from it to refill your cores.

title: Willard's Rest
description: Home to [The Widow of Willard's Rest](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6818)

title: Cairn Lodge
description: Visited during [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42).

title: Chez Porter
description: Climb the ladder inside the barn to the upper floor and the stash box is beside some hay stacks. The treasure box holds two money clips and a jewelry bag.

title: Veteran's Homestead
description: Home to [The Veteran](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6816).

title: Van Horn Mansion
description:
Visit early in the game and you'll find two residents inside. Go in at night, when both are asleep on the lower floor. Steal the money from their table and loot everything else in the house.

(You will not lose honor for killing or stealing from these folks)

title: Catfish Jacksons
description: A father and son live in this homestead, although sometimes only the son is there. The shotgun is in the living room; threaten the son to find out where the [stash](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=810) is.

title: Six Point Cabin
description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=401)

title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 1
description:
**Note: May not spawn until starting [All That Glitters](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=36).**

Come at [Caliban's Seat](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=150) from the south and you can ride all the way up. Once at the top, don't go to the small camp at the far end yet; instead, go down to the right and follow the path along the narrow cliff side.

The treasure map is there, in a small gap in the wall, along with a pearl necklace - sell it, or hand it to Tilly when she asks for one in Chapter 2.

_The next map is found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=38)._

title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 2
description:
**Note: May not spawn until you've found [All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37).**

Search the pile of rocks that has the large rock on top.



_The final treasure is found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=39)._

title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Treasure
description:
Reach the island from the peninsula on its western side so you don't drown. Take the boat by a shack on the eastern shore, or swim out to the small island in the middle of the lake and check the bushes. The treasure is buried under a rock.  

**Treasure:** Gold Bar x2

**Note:** May not appear until you've found [Map 1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37) and [Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=38).

title: Money Lending and Other Sins
description:
~$35 in the hollow tree

You need [Chick's Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=928381).

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 2
description: In the hollow tree at Face Rock

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3
description: You'll find **Poisonous Trail Map 3** on top of the [Serpent Mound](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=906), among the stones that resemble a nest of eggs.

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure
description:
**NB: Bring a lantern to see inside the cave, and make sure you've collected the [Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=174), or this treasure won't spawn.**

Go through the waterfall to reach the secret cave. Climb over the first ledge and drop down the steep slope. Find another steep path on the right and follow it down.  If you reach a huge chamber lit by natural light, you've gone too far.

Next you'll reach a small triangular tunnel entrance that you must crouch to get through.  After passing it, take the path on the right.  When the chamber opens up, there's a ledge you have to run off and jump from. You'll land below and slide into some water, then climb one last ledge and search for a boulder to find 4 x gold bars ($500).

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Start
description:
In the lockbox under a bed in the cabin where Flaco Hernandez appears during [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42) - you don't need to progress that questline, though.

The hunt continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=173).

title: High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 2
description:
**Requirements:** High Stakes Treasure Map 1, bought or looted from a treasure hunter in a random event. If you miss the chance three times, a fence will sell the map.

The second map is behind the waterfall here.  Climb up a log to get into the waterfall. 

_Tip: Use first person view if you can't see anything after entering the waterfall._

**Next Map:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=307)

title: High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3
description:
**Requirements:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306)

The third map is in a hole in a log that spans from the island to the shore.  You have to reach the log from the south side of the island.

title: High Stakes Treasure
description:
**Requirements:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=307)

Facing the river, follow the left path along the cliff edge.  You'll go past a Rock Carving.  Take the path above it.  Then jump down a gap.  Then drop down once more (this time you'll take damage).  Crawl under a nearby ledge to find 3 x gold bars ($500 each)

title: Otis Miller's Treasure
description:
Concealed inside a small cave.

**Note:** Only available from Epilogue 1 onward.

title: Reed Cottage Treasure - Start
description: Inside the chimney of Reed Cottage

title: Reed Cottage Treasure
description:
**Requirements:** [Sketched Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=664) from Reed Cottage  
**Reward:** 1 Gold Ingot ($300)

Out in the open, beneath a small rock behind a larger one.

title: Gold Bar
description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 4 onwards.

**SPOILERS:** The treasure is a few steps to the left of the corpse, in a lockbox beneath a wall left of the doorway.

title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Start
description:
In the jail cell, on the bed.

**Note:** Only available to those who pre-ordered the digital version of Red Dead Redemption 2 for the PlayStation 4 or Xbox One prior to August 15, 2018.

title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Map 2
description:
**Prerequisites:** [Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19255)

In the underground passage, set into the dirt wall by a wooden crate with a lamp on it. Watch for a white 'X' carved into the top beam.

title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure
description:
In the small chapel - behind one of the plates.  

**Prerequisites:** [Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19256)  
**Reward:** 6 Gold Bars ($500 each at the Fence).

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Start
description: Shoot down the hanging corpse and loot _The Elemental Trail Map 1_ from it.

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 2
description: The Elemental Trail Map 2 is in the fireplace of the ruined house.

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3
description: The Elemental Trail Map 3 is on the wooden walkway overhead. Reach it from the wooden platform on the hill to the east.

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure
description:
Next to the grave by the tree and gate.

**Reward:** 
- Crow Beak Trinket (Looted ammo increased by 10%)
- Large Gold Bar

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Start
description: Go to the west side of the obelisk, where the engraved plaque is. The map is hidden behind the plaque.

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 2
description: Beneath the bell on the roof of the Tiny Church

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 3
description:
On the roof of the Mysterious Hill Home - behind the lower boarded-up window.

May only appear during the daytime.

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 4
description: In the tree on the hill at the center of the Bolger Glade civil war battlefield.

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure
description:
Beneath a rock at the foot of the sundial on top of Mount Shann

**Treasure:** 6 x Gold Bar

**Note** - You must have found the [Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 4](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21252) for it to spawn.

title: Nevada Hat
description:
Behind the waterfall, at about the same height as the railroad. Come from the east and drop onto a path, then head toward the waterfall and the hat is on a rock.

Under the hat lies the suicide note of Robert Elliot - a character from the Stars of the Stage cigarette cards.

**Note:** Fish (Perch, Chain Pickerel, Bluegill, Rock Bass & Sockeye Salmon) also tumble down the nearby waterfall and land on the cliff edge, which makes this a very handy spot for Master Hunter Challenge 8.

title: Viking Helmet
description: In a cave by the stone altar, where the Viking Hatchet is found.

title: Pig Mask
description: Hanging next to a pig carcass and some sausages in the shack.

title: Cat Skull Mask
description: Inside an abandoned building at the water's edge

title: Pagan Skull Mask
description: This mask is on a corpse ringed by ritualistic markings on the ground.

title: Civil War Hardee Hat
description: In the basement of Fort Brennand. The basement entrance is in the hut, behind some crates at the back right.

title: Tricorn Hat
description:
This pirate hat is behind a wooden wall inside the shipwreck.

To cross the water, hijack a passing boat or ride your horse over at the shallowest point

title: True Tales of Frank Heck, No.102
description: On a nightstand inside the shack.

title: Meteorite #2
description: In the hole in the floor inside the [Meteor House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=152)

title: Torn Treasure Map 2
description:
In a drawer inside the hermit's shack. 

This map is half of a whole. The other half can be found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=379).

title: Wild West Heroes, No. 132
description: On a nightstand in the house at Downes Ranch.

title: Otis Miller and the Arabian Prince
description: On a nightstand inside the shack.

title: Torn Treasure Map 1
description:
In a drawer in front of a window in the hermit's shack.

This map is half of a whole. The other half can be found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=372).

title: Otis Miller and the Black-Hearted Lady
description: This book lies on a nightstand inside the Osman Grove shack.

title: Otis Miller and the Boy from New York
description: On a table in the abandoned schoolhouse.

title: Abalone Shell Fragment
description:
Inside an old house just north of the Sheriff's Station.

Needed to craft the Bison Horn Talisman.

title: Ram Skull Mask
description:
Hanging from one of the wooden pillars of the abandoned pergola.

Wear it to hide your identity while committing crimes.

title: Miner's Hat
description:
On a corpse next to the [Wide-Blade Knife](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=371). Use the plunger at the entrance to blast the rocks blocking the way.

This hat is extremely handy, since it has a built-in light - so you can see in the dark without carrying your lantern.

title: Morion Helmet
description: On the body of the [Frozen Settler](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=896).

title: Cobalt Petrified Wood
description:
In a chest on a cart, right under a large overhanging rock. The chest also holds some money.

Needed to craft a Boar Tusk Talisman at the Fence.

title: Ancient Viking Comb
description:
On a shelf with 4 skulls, next to the Viking Helmet. Smash the skulls open and the comb is underneath.

To make sure you keep it, wait until the epilogue to collect the comb.

title: Scarecrow Hat
description: On top of the scarecrow in the field (shoot it off the scarecrow to collect it).

title: Female Fertility Statue
description: In a lockbox under the chair on the porch of the [Roadside Brothel](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30355).

title: Fertility Statue
description: Hidden in the chimney of [The Old Bacchus Place](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=36718).

title: Gold Shield
description:
You can take this item from Braithwaite Manor, but **only** during the chapter 3 mission *Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern*. 

It sits on a mantelpiece downstairs, in the first room on the left.

title: Ancient Necklace
description: **Location:** In a drawer inside the Scratching Post shack.

title: Panoramic Map
description: One of several possible spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple in a random event.

title: Faded Letter
description:
**Location:** In a lock box under a tree.
  
**Description:** Letter to Douglas Gray from Lucille Braithwaite

title: Chinese Skullcap
description: **Location:** Next to the corpse of a Chinese man.  The body also carries the "Letter to Zhou Yi from Zhou Wei"

title: Ammolite & Fluorite
description:
2 unique gemstones lie in a birds nest on a high ledge in the mountains.  The route is tricky - come from the north, just above the train tracks, and hop across the rock ledges.

The fence buys them for $25 each, and on the way you'll also pass a lockbox containing [Aged Pirate Rum, Bill Fold & Coin Bag](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=822).

title: Ancient Arrowhead
description:
**Required:** Find all 20 [Dreamcatchers](https://rdr2map.com?search=dreamcatcher)

Linking every Dreamcatcher point on the map draws a buffalo. In Elysian Cave, the item is inside the cave painting of the buffalo.

title: Hawk Talon Trinket
description:
Behind the waterfall at Deadboot Creek, in a lockbox.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** 30% stamina drain decrease when drawing a bow

title: Cat Eye Trinket
description:
In a lock box next to a crate.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** Permanently increases the length of Fortifying tonic effects by 20%

title: Shark Tooth Trinket
description:
In a lock box beside the shipwreck.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** Permanently increases player's horse bonding experience by 10%.

title: Turtle Shell Trinket
description:
In a lock box beneath the stairs. You can only take it after killing all the Del Lobo enemies nearby.

**Ability:** Permanently increases player's health bar refill speed by 10%.

title: Scarecrow Derby Hat
description: On the scarecrow

title: Scarecrow Sombrero
description: Worn by a scarecrow in the corn. Shoot it off once Dutch lifts the ban on guns in Rhodes, or ride your horse into the scarecrow to knock it over.

title: Scarecrow Top Hat
description: On the scarecrow. Shoot it off.

title: Meteorite #1
description: In the crater

title: Shrunken Head
description: In the small cabin.  Shoot the small clay jar under the painting to get the Shrunken Head.

title: Letter to Uncle Lewis from Elijah
description: On the body of a runaway slave

title: Electric Lantern
description: Once you've finished [A Bright Bouncing Boy (II)](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454739), go back to his lab after 48 in-game hours have passed.

title: Letter to Garfield from Martha
description: On a dead soldier who is pinned to a tree by a bayonet-style rifle driven through him.  A "traitor" sign hangs from his neck, and the letter is around his right pocket.  You may need Dead Eye to spot the letter.

title: The Lady of the Manor
description:
***Epilogue Only***

Mary-Beth gives it to you when you meet her at the train station.

title: Letter to Annette from Claude
description:
Inside Robard Farm are the corpses of a man and a woman.

Behind the farm, another woman's body lies against a wagon wheel with a Cattleman revolver in her hand.  Loot her body to find this letter, which explains why they're all dead.

title: Dutch's Speech Notes
description:
On a crate at the very southern end of the Horseshoe Overlook camp.

Only found during Chapter 2.

title: Panoramic Map
description: One of several possible spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple in a random event.

title: Catherine's Brooch
description:
Can be sold to a fence. A [Large Gold Bar](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=812) is also in the house.

**Note:** Only available after the Chapter 3 mission _"Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern"_

title: Old Brass Compass
description:
Reward for finishing [Geology for Beginners](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=124). 

Needed to craft the _Raven Claw Talisman_.

title: Panoramic Map
description: One of several possible spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple in a random event.

title: Panama Fedora, Boater Hat, Military Cavalry Hat & Gaucho Hat
description:
All worn by assorted NPC's at the Rhodes post office.

If you steal them, they show up in your collection when you change clothes.

title: Lost Letter to Bonnie
description: A corpse hands it to you during the Bad Luck, Bonnie random event.

title: Experiment Notes
description: Four experiment notes are in the room with the [Manmade Mutant](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=873).

title: English Spelling Practice
description:
By the entrance of the burnt church, a letter written by the native students at Fort Riggs.

Take the first letter of every word and it spells out a secret message:

_Waziya comes with winter breath_    
_His trees stand guard whispering all night that we sleep in our grave_    
_Father fought and died so quickly_     
_Mother dies slow_

title: Letter from Cornwall Kerosene and Tar
description: On a corpse at the Oil Derrick

title: Liability Agreement
description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [The Wisdom of the Elders](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6817) V

On a table in Butcher’s Creek

title: Letter to Martha from Garfield
description: On the table in the cabin at Martha's Swain.

title: Grave Newspaper Clipping
description: On a table in the shack.

title: Letter from St. Luke's Academy
description: Loot it from one of the corpses during the third [Appleseed Timber](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2414) event, once the wolves are dead.

title: Classic Raccoon Mountain Hat
description:
Look for a large man named [Jon](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=944) in the Valentine saloon, wearing this iconic hat. Let him talk, then provoke him and stare him down. Eventually he'll start a fight with you. Pick up his hat once the brawl is over.

_Note: This is a different hat than the one available at the Trapper in the Trophy Buck garment set._

title: Letter to Jim from Mildred
description: Turns up on the porch some time after you meet the [Wagon Accident](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785)

title: Wild Man's Journal
description: On the animal skeleton at the northern end of the Wolfman's Cave.

title: Letter to Micah from Amos
description: During Chapter 4, on a crate outside the boathouse, you'll find a letter from Micah's brother to him.

title: Letter to Glen and Eddie from Momma
description: In the nightstand drawer by the beds.

title: Meeting Notes
description: Loot it from a KKK Klansman in dark robes at any of their random encounter spots.

title: Native American Ring
description:
Found only on the Drunk Stranger, met at a camp in a random encounter.

He falls asleep during the encounter, so you can loot the ring peacefully.

title: Nite Folk Victim's Note

description: On an old stone altar in the Roanoke Valley area of New Hanover, stuck in a skull. It can be thrown as well.

title: Rare Shotgun
description:
Carried by a Hermit who lives in the [Manito Glade](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30358) shack. Kill him (or knock him out) to take the weapon.

He appears only on your first visit to the shack, so remember to grab it (though he may rise from the dead and let you loot it again after 3-4 in-game days!)

title: Broken Pirate Sword
description: Stuck inside a shipwreck

title: Midnight's Pistol
description:
**Requirements:** The Noblest of Man, and a Woman stranger mission.

You get this pistol by killing Billy Midnight.

Talk to the train station clerk, who will tell you Billy Midnight is on one of the next two trains. Wait outside and get on the first train that pulls in. Midnight is in the last wagon. Chase him down and duel him.

title: Schofield Revolver
description:
To get the revolver, first go around to the back of the Doctor's Office and look in through the window. This unlocks a hidden operation.

Then rob the store and kill the men in the back room. The revolver is in a box on the table.

title: Flaco's Revolver
description:
Once you have made progress in [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42), you will come here to talk to Flaco Hernandez. It ends badly, but after he is dead you can take his revolver.

*Note - if you don't pick it up, it may disappear by the time you return.*

**Requirements:** Complete "American Venom" (Epilogue 2)

Micah’s Revolver lies at the summit of Mount Hagen, on his frozen corpse.

**Location:** In a chest inside a cave, along with a sticky handful of photographs.

title: Carbine Repeater

A Carbine Repeater lies here, on a hilltop, held by a corpse that sits upright, half buried in snow. A marker appears on the minimap as you get near.

This probably nods to the Hatchet Jack scene in the film Jeremiah Johnson.

title: Tomahawk

**SPOILER:** You have to draw on Calloway and kill him.

Obtained at the end of the mission _Magicians For Sport_, from the body of a bounty hunter in the barn. 

**Note:** You can get this weapon only during the mission. If you miss it on your first playthrough of the mission, you can't obtain it - but you can still add it to your compendium.

title: Bad Luck, Bonnie
description:
This is one of several possible spawn spots for a 'corpse' carrying the [Lost Letter to Bonnie](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454465). He hands it over when you try to loot him.

There are also two chests close by, with loot that includes a Silver Pocket Watch & Gin, Guarma Rum, Shotgun Shells, Money & Chewing Tobacco.

title: High Stakes Treasure Hunter
description:
Carries the first High Stakes Treasure Map. Rob him, kill and loot him, or buy it from him for $5.

If you fail to get the map from him on 3 separate occasions, it can be bought at a Fence instead.

The treasure hunt goes on [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306).

title: Nite Folk Victim
description:
Visit at night to find a man hanging from a tree beside the road. Once you walk up to the body, three enemies from a faction called the **Nite Folk.** attack you.

When they are dead, shoot the body down and loot it to get the [Nite Folk Victim's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892454)

On the second time you run into this event, you get the [Nite Folk Wagerer's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892455)

title: Ku Klux Klan Meeting
description:
This is one of many possible spots for a KKK meeting.

They are usually hostile when approached. Kill and loot a Klansman in dark robes to get the unique [Meeting Notes](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892449) letter.

title: Crying Woman
description:
While roaming the swamps, you may hear a woman crying. Approach her and she attacks, then runs off. Shoot her from a distance to get a good look at her mottled gray skin and white eyes, or chase her and get attacked by a group of Nite Folk.

It gets creepier still. Camp nearby and sleep until midnight, then use focus, and you will see the tracks of a "Stranger" heading away from your sleeping spot... straight to the "crying" woman.

title: Arm Amputation
description:
A man on a horse calls out for help, then falls off. He asks you to bring him to a doctor in Saint Denis, where you can hang around and watch them saw his arm off.

Some days later, he can be found being hanged for killing a woman who mocked his disfigurement. You can help him once more, or leave him to his fate.

title: Ghost of Agnes Dowd
description:
Happens during foggy weather between 9pm - 3am

Agnes shows up as a white ghost, or is completely invisible, and you can hear her crying. Look through your binoculars, because she fades away if you get too close.  

This event can be encountered 16 times, with 2 in-game days between encounters.  She has unique dialog each time.  After the 16th, she no longer spawns.

title: Cave Hermit
description:
Happens from Chapter 2 onward  

There are 5 possible stages, each one open at least 3 in-game days after the one before. Stay near him long enough to hear everything he says (and to actually see him), even when he tells you to leave.

title: Blind Man Cassidy

Give this mystical blind man a dollar and he shares cryptic visions of the future.

He turns up in multiple locations and shares 18 different visions in total (with roughly 3 in-game days needing to pass between encounters.) 

8 more visions are available in the Epilogue.

title: O'Driscoll Debt Collection

Two O'Driscolls are beating a man by a tree. They demand he pay what he owes - what happens next is your call.

_If you intervene,_ you get Honor after fighting the two O'Driscolls. 

_If you do not intervene,_ the man is knocked out and you lose Honor.

You can hear a woman shouting - she has been tied up and thrown across the back of a horse! 

Kill or hogtie the would-be kidnapper to gain honor.

You can also hogtie him and hand him over to any sheriff for a cash reward.

title: Blind Man Cassidy
description:
Happens from Chapter 2 onward. 

Give this mystical blind man a dollar and he shares cryptic visions of the future.

He turns up in multiple locations and shares 18 different visions in total (with roughly 3 in-game days needing to pass between encounters.) 

8 more visions are available in the Epilogue.

description:
At night, go to the end of this T-shaped junction at the corner of the church and a stranger offers to sell you weapons.

Follow him, and money will surely change hands. Come back here afterwards to get it back.

description:
At night, look through the house's window and you will see a woman spanking a bare-assed man.

You can keep watching until you are caught and lose honor.

title: The Accident
description:
At night, a prostitute may ask you to help get rid of a body. She killed a man in her room at the saloon and needs help with it. She rewards you with money, and if you return in a few days, she comes to you with a similar problem. Help her again and you lose Honor.


**Tip:** Go back to Valentine in the Epilogue and talk to the bartender in the [Saloon](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=168). He tells you the prostitute was really a serial killer and has been caught; visit the sheriff's office to find her in one of the jail cells. After that, you can see her hanged near the [Butcher](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=166).

title: Wagon Accident
description:
A stranger may call you over to the cliff, where a wagon has wrecked on the rocks below.

Search the body down below for the [Bride's Photograph](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892803), and a lockbox on the wagon for the [Wedding Certificate](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892804)

title: Cougar Attack

A man is hiding up a tree from a furious cougar. 

Kill the cougar to rescue him and gain Honor.

A man is panning for gold by the river. 

He says he has found nothing and asks you to move on. Stay in the area and the man may find a gold nugget... which you can steal.

At night, you can see two men peeking through the window. Join them and you will see a man and woman rolling around on the bed and floor while smoking a pipe. 

You can chase the men off to gain honor, but peeking yourself costs you honor, and you keep losing more the longer you watch.

He carries the first High Stakes Treasure Map. You'll have to rob him, kill and loot him, or buy it from him for $5.

If you fail to get the map from him on 3 separate occasions, it goes on sale at a Fence.

The treasure hunt goes on [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306).

title: Classic Bill

Javier may come to you with word that Bill has been cornered by bounty hunters.

Nothing bad happens to Bill if you refuse, but if you step in, you'll fight beside Javier and earn some honor.

A prisoner might ask you to shoot off his chains. If you free him, he'll hand you a Home Robbery tip.

You can also hogtie him and hand him over to any sheriff for a cash reward.

title: Safe-Breakers

Two men are trying to crack open a safe by whatever means they can.

You can blow it open yourself with dynamite, or hold back until the men get it open and then swoop in and take the loot.

Letting the fugitive go earns you a Store Robbery tip.

title: Snake Bite Victim

A stranger might come up to you and beg for help with a snakebite. Give him a health cure or suck the venom out yourself to save him and earn honor.

Some in-game days later, you might meet the stranger in a nearby settlement, where he'll pay for your next purchase at a local shop.

title: Camper
description:
A friendly stranger might have a camp here. 

Sit down with them and they'll tell you a story about their time working at Emerald Ranch, and the rumours surrounding Miriam Wegner.

title: Camper
description:

Two men may come out of the post office, one of them showing off a new revolver. He waves it around and jokingly points it at his friend, who tells him to quit. He ignores his friend and accidentally shoots himself in the leg.

The two then leave, and the man hobbles around town for a while before settling on the porch of the doctor's office with a cigarette.

title: Snowfield Shack Cheat Code
description:
Etched into a drawer in the shack is the cheat code "You flourish before you die".

This cheat fills your Health, Stamina, and Dead Eye bars completely.

title: Deer Cottage Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "You want more than you have" is etched into the top drawer of a dresser in the [Deer Cottage](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30360).

This cheat spawns a superior horse right in front of you.

title: Ambarino Sign Cheat Code
description:
You'll spot the cheat code "Make Me Better" etched into a plank that forms the large 'R' on the wooden train track supports. 

This cheat raises your Dead Eye proficiency to level 2. With Dead Eye level 2 active, you can mark targets manually in Dead Eye.

title: Red Wagon Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "You want everyone to go away" is etched into the wagon.

This cheat clears any bounties you have built up and ends any lockdowns you have caused.

title: Vetter's Echo Cheat Code
description:
Pick up the [Black Widow Spider](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=744) cigarette card and search the desk drawers beneath it; "You Want Punishment" is carved into the top drawer.

This cheat raises your wanted level.

title: Cairn Lake Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Keep your dreams simple" is carved into the ice.

This cheat spawns a wagon right in front of you.

title: Two Crows Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "The best of the old ways" is carved into the wood inside the shack.

This cheat spawns a stagecoach right in front of you.

title: Dilapidated House Cheat Code
description:
Enter the shack to find the code "You want something new".

This cheat spawns a random horse right in front of you.

title: Fort Riggs Cheat Code
description:
"RUN! RUN! RUN!" is written on the chalkboard inside the building.

This cheat spawns a race horse right in front of you.

title: Lannahechee Shipwreck Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Better than my dog" is etched into the ship.

This cheat extends your whistle range, so your horse can find you from any distance.

title: Millesani Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "A fool on command" is written in red, hidden in a corner inside the mine.

This cheat makes you drunk right away.

title: Rio Bravo Island Cheat Code
description:
"My kingdom is a horse" is etched into a rock on this island.

This cheat raises your bonding with all the horses you own.

title: Houseboat Cheat Code
description:
Climb across to the end of the little boathouse to find the code "Seek all the bounty of this place"

This cheat raises your Health, Stamina, and Dead Eye bar levels.

title: Cattail Cheat Code
description:
Enter the railway tunnel to find the cheat code "I seek and I find".

This cheat raises your Dead Eye proficiency to level 5. With Dead Eye level 5 active, critical areas are highlighted in addition to fatal areas while in Dead Eye.

title: Owanjila Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "I still seek more" is located beneath the Owanjila Dam.

This cheat raises your Dead Eye proficiency to level 4. With Dead Eye level 4 active, fatal areas get highlighted while in Dead Eye.

title: Clemens Cove Shipwreck Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "I shall be better" is on the front of the shipwreck.

This cheat raises your Dead Eye proficiency to level 3. With Dead Eye level 3 active, you stay in Dead Eye after firing your weapon.

title: Sunken Boat Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Be greedy only for foresight" is inside the cabin of the sunken boat.

This cheat enables Infinite Dead Eye.

title: Lookout Tower Cheat Code
description:
Look at the top of the tower on the east-facing side to find the cheat code "Balance. All is balance". It is etched into the top board of the half-wall.

This cheat sets your Honor back to absolute neutrality.

title: Barnhouse Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "You revel in your disgrace, I see" is on the upper floor of the barnhouse.

This cheat drops your Honor level to the lowest possible value.

title: Bacchus Cave Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Greed is now a virtue" is inside this small cave.

This cheat hands you $500 each time it is activated.

title: Caretaker House Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "A simple life, a beautiful death" is in the drawer of the shack. Open it to find the code.

This cheat unlocks a loadout of basic weapons.

title: Cornwall K&T Cheat Code
description:

This cheat spawns a buggy right in front of you, as shown in the screenshot.

title: Pink Wagon Cheat Code
description:

This cheat raises your deadeye proficiency to level 1. With Dead Eye level 1 active, your Dead Eye marks targets automatically.

title: Lake Don Julio House Cheat Code
description:

title: Fence's Shop Cheat Code
description:
Inside the [Fence's shop](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19), the cheat code "Vanity. All is Vanity" is etched into the top drawer of the first cabinet on your right.

This cheat unlocks all outfits.

title: Pleasance House Cheat Code
description:
There is a chest inside [Pleasance House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30404) with the cheat code "Share" etched into it.

This cheat fills the camp's supplies to the maximum and unlocks every camp upgrade.

title: Trading Post Cheat Code
description:
Enter the shack and look up at the ceiling to spot the cheat code "History is written by fools".

This cheat unlocks a loadout of gunslinger weapons.

title: Adler Ranch Cheat Code
description:
The code "Death Is Silence" is on the support beam of the burnt remains of the main house.

This cheat unlocks a loadout of stealth weapons.

title: Benedict Pass Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "You want freedom" is carved underneath the bridge.

This cheat lowers your wanted level.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code I (Chapter 1)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=46) (New Hanover Gazette No. 27) in Chapter 1 to get the cheat code "Abundance is the dullest desire".

This cheat code gives you unlimited ammo, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code II (Chapter 3)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=33) (Saint Denis Times #46) once the Chapter 3 mission 'Advertising, The Old American Art' is done to get the cheat code "Greed is American Virtue".

This cheat code unlocks a loadout of heavy weapons, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code III (Chapter 3)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=46) (New Hanover Gazette #31) once the Chapter 3 mission 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' is done to get the cheat code "You long for sight and see nothing".

This cheat code clears all the fog from the world map.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code IV (Chapter 4)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #67) once the Chapter 4 mission 'Urban Pleasures' is done to get the cheat code "Virtue unearned is not virtue".

This cheat code raises your Honor level to the highest possible value, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code V (Chapter 5)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #68) after you come back from Guarma in Chapter 5 to get the cheat code "The lucky be strong evermore".

This cheat code enables infinite stamina, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code VI (Chapter 6)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2245) (New Hanover Gazette #36) once the Chapter 6 mission 'The King's Son' is done to get the cheat code "You seek more than the world offers".

This cheat code restores and boosts your health, stamina, and Dead Eye, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code VII (Epilogue 1)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #72) once the Epilogue Part 1 mission 'The Wheel' is done to get the cheat code "You are a beast built for war".

This cheat code spawns a war horse right in front of you, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code VIII (Epilogue 1)
description:
Buy a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2248) (The Blackwater Ledger #73) once the Epilogue 1 mission 'The Landowning Classes' is done to get the cheat code "Would you be happier as a clown?"

This cheat code spawns a circus wagon right in front of you, but it can only be activated once you have read the newspaper.

title: UFO

title: Massive Dead Snake

title: Witch's Cauldron
description: A cauldron full of an unknown liquid. If you drink it, you black out and wake up several yards away with all cores refilled to the maximum.

title: Robot
description:
**Requirements:** Complete chapter 4 mission "Joys of Civilization", Complete Marko Dragic stranger missions

When you use the [Electric Lantern](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=25042), its light turns red/orange as you near the robot

title: Conversation with a Giant - Starting Point
description:
**Requirements:** Study at least 30 animals

Arrive here on a **clear day** (not rainy, stormy, snowy or foggy) and a flock of birds takes off from the shore.  Follow them to an [inaccessible cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=927#L). A conversation with a kind-hearted giant starts on its own.

Come back 3 days later for a second conversation, and there are two more in the Epilogue.

title: Ghost Train
description: Appears along this section of track, usually in the dead of night or around 3AM.

title: Deformed Singer
description: Sits on the porch playing a banjo

title: Vampire
description:
**Requirements:** Find the 5 vampire clues: [#1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=875), [#2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=876), [#3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=877), [#4](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=878), [#5](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=879) 

Once all 5 clues are found, a vampire waits here, finishing off his latest victim.  Killing him rewards you with an Ornate Dagger

**Note:** Come at night, as he may not always spawn. Appears between 00:00 and 01:00.

**Tip:** If you killed him but can't find the dagger, it can be bought from the Fence.

title: Conversation with a Giant - Cave
description:
**Requirements:** Study at least 30 animals 

This is the cave where you can meet the Giant (without seeing him), after following [this flock of birds](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=730#L).

Come back 3 days later for a second conversation, and there are two more in the Epilogue.

title: Mexico Glitch
description:
**Requirements:** Max horse stamina, stamina + health stimulants & revivers.

**Note:** Make a save before trying this glitch.

First, ford the river at its narrowest point, across from this marker.  Your horse needs stamina + health stimulants to survive the crossing.

Next, go to this marked location.  Ride your horse into the end of the canyon and try to glitch yourself onto the top ledge (if your horse dies you can use cheats - but save before doing so).

In time you can glitch up onto the canyon top and explore all of Mexico.

title: Glowing Pentagram
description: A red glowing pentagram shows up beneath a small shack here between 4am and 5am

title: Whiskey Tree
description:
A gold nugget is inside one of the bottles hanging on this tree.  Use Eagle Eye to highlight the right bottle, then shoot it to get the gold nugget.

A Ginseng Elixir also sits in the center of the tree

title: Sheep Lover
description: A [Gold Wedding Ring](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=369) is tied to his "wife"

title: Josiah Trelawny's House
description: Climb the stairs here to overhear a conversation inside the Trelawny home. Wait long enough and Arthur calls out to him for a short chat.

title: Missing Princess Poster
description: On the saloon's outer wall. A poster offering a reward for the missing _Princess Isabeau Katharina Zinsmeister_

title: Manzanita Post Mystery
description:
A small group of Norwegian immigrants lives in this area. This mystery has 3 items to find:

- **Norwegian Journal Page** - inside the chimney of the small cabin.  
- **Norwegian Photo** - under a loose floorboard.  
- **Norwegian Newspaper Scrap** - taken from the husband's body.  

Translate these items to learn a dark secret about the people living here.

title: Alchemist's House
description: The first time you walk up to this house, you witness the alchemist's final experiment!

title: The Whispering Forest
description:
Walk through the forest while it is foggy and you will hear 2 voices whispering.

Watch "The Ghastly Serenade" at a theatre to learn the story behind these voices

title: Taxidermy Gorilla
description: A life-sized gorilla statue lies hidden on the steep slopes of the Big Valley mountains, just northwest of Wallace Station, looking like it dropped right off a circus cargo.

title: Frozen Cattle Drive
description: A herd of cattle left frozen in the snow after a failed drive.

title: Well
description: At the bottom of the well in front of the repossessed house are 4 quarters and many carved tally marks and crosses on the wall - hinting that someone was held down there against their will.

title: Strange Man Portrait

title: UFO #2
description: Once you have found the mysterious sermon and seen the [first UFO](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=181) at [Hani's Bethel](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=190), climb to the peak of Mount Shann and wait until around midnight / 1AM / 2AM for another glimpse of life beyond the stars.

title: Rains Fall

***Epilogue Only***

title: Meteor Shower
description: Around 2:30 - 3 AM, a meteor shower is visible in the field by the [Meteor House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=152) if the sky is clear. Coming from the south-west is the easiest way to reach the spot.

title: Joshua Burgess
description:
This gravestone ties into a story told through a letter found elsewhere on the map, in a wrecked mail truck.

The gravestone reads "Joshua Burgess Accidentally shot August 1898". The shooting happened less than a year before the story begins. The letter tells of a relationship between the daughter of Emerald Ranch's owner and a young man. 

The ranch owner disapproved of the relationship and shot the young man in the saloon, where blood on the floor and bullet holes in the walls still remain from the shooting.

title: Miriam Wegner
description: Miriam appears at the upstairs window, looking out, around midnight and noon.

title: Workers' Gravestone
description: A lone wooden headstone carries the "names" of workers who died building the railroad. Small piles of clothing lie nearby.

title: El Presidio
description:
Look over the river to see this iconic fort, which held the Mexican army in the first Red Dead Redemption.

It can't be reached without the [Mexico Glitch](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=966)

title: Precarious Wagon
description: A wagon sits teetering at the edge of a cliff. Climb in and you immediately slide forward and plunge to your death. As if that weren't enough, the game dramatically zooms in as it happens.

title: "Why" Trees
description: Several burned and splintered trees, likely struck by lightning, stand here. Seen from one particular angle, they spell out the word "WHY".

title: Hanging Man & Hearse
description: A hearse looks to have been attacked here, its coffin lying open. The driver, or maybe the corpse being carried, hangs from the vehicle.

title: Legendary Channel Catfish
description:
**Note:** The Legendary Channel Catfish cannot be obtained and is only mentioned when Jeremy Gill tries to catch it during _"A Fisher of Fish II"_.

_After you complete the mission, The Legendary Channel Catfish becomes visible on the map like any other legendary fish, but still cannot be caught._

title: Ghosts of Bolger Glade

title: Tilly Jackson

***Epilogue Only***

title: Chain Gang

title: Cave Painting

title: Shiver Me Timbers

Grave marker for a "Cowboy of No Name" - a nod to the "Man With No Name" from _The Good, the Bad and the Ugly_.

title: Evelyn Miller Camp
description: Note: Becomes available after "The American Inferno, Burnt Out II".

title: Fort Riggs
description:
An abandoned fort once used by the US Army to hold captured Native Americans. A drunk army veteran tells the fort's story during a random stranger encounter.

A letter in the main building looks like practice at spelling various english words. Write down the first letter of every word and a secret poem appears.
